Our homepage carries two badges side by side: the SEC seal, because SEC registration means you are working with a firm held to the highest standard, and a Client Choice badge with no date on it and no name of the organization that produced it. No fee was paid to be considered for the rating and nothing is paid to display it, and we reviewed its survey before using the badge and have a reasonable basis to believe it is not designed to produce a predetermined result. Fee-only planning, with fees stated in writing before any work begins.
